usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-reminders` command and listed it in `help` directly after `run-late-fees`. It charges a one-time 5.00 fee on unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due, and the fee counts toward the invoice's outstanding amount and the customer's balance. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (9 of 9), and the work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
One open question: the fee rule doesn't mention premium customers, so I left them out, the same way they're left out of late fees. Finance needs to confirm that.
